requirements.title: A pressure breach becomes critical only after the authored sustain
requirements.description: When a host-pressure reading crosses a setpoint bar, vrooli-autoheal shall report a warning until the bar's authored sustain has elapsed, then critical; a reading under the bar shall reset the window.

validation.notes: Sustain comes from internal/setpoint (one reader); failing-before capture: /home/matthalloran8/.vrooli/plan-artifacts/polite-host/evidence/p06/failing-before.txt

requirements.title: A sustained fork storm attributed to an agent session scope is frozen, recorded, and reversible
requirements.description: When the emergency watchdog's last report carries a sustained fork-rate or cpu-pressure finding whose top parent runs in a scope under vrooli-agents.slice, vrooli-autoheal shall freeze that scope through the runtime recovery gate, record a runtime_recovery_decisions row keyed <epoch>/<scope>/contain-storm, and name the thaw command on the incident; it shall refuse any scope that is not an agent session scope, refuse when recovery coordination is unreadable, and `vrooli agent thaw <scope>` shall reverse the freeze.

validation.notes: Supervisor and resource scopes refused on the cgroup path, never the name
Unreadable runtime registry = closed gate; a refusal still leaves a decision row
Freeze, idempotency key, working directory and thaw command on the next run's finding
Attribution without a listed (sustained) finding is not a target
A thawed scope drops out of containment and can be contained again
containStorm=propose_only marks the action Dangerous so auto-heal never selects it
The thaw command resolves unit names through the user manager and refuses non-agent scopes

requirements.title: A critical incident counts as reached only when a delivery attempt was delivered
